entries.en: He's in rough shape, but... alive.
entries.en_m: He's in rough shape... but alive.
entries.ro: E cam șifonat, dar... e în viață.

entries.en: Hey, got a status? Find the package?
entries.ro: Hei, ce-i cu statusul? Ai găsit pachetul?

entries.en: You pay for what you did!
<kiroshi l="jpn" o="死ね、ハルヨシ！" t="You're dead, Haruyoshi!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="死ね、ハルヨシ！" t="Ești mort, Haruyoshi!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Let's hear what Dennis has to say...
entries.ro: Hai să auzim ce zice Dennis...

entries.en: Could've told me this "package" is a person.
entries.ro: Puteai să-mi zici că „pachetul” ăsta e om.

entries.en: He's a little worse for wear, but no issues. What's next?
entries.ro: E un pic șifonat, dar fără probleme. Ce urmează?

entries.en: You coulda told me the "package" was a man.
entries.ro: Puteai să-mi spui că „pachetul” era un bărbat.

entries.en: I prepared a car for you. Put the man in the trunk and head to Northside. The address is in the GPS.
entries.ro: Ți-am pregătit o mașină. Bagă-l pe tip în portbagaj și du-te în Northside. Adresa e în GPS.

entries.en: If it was a box of bananas I'd've used the post office. Get over it.
entries.ro: Dacă era o cutie de banane, trimiteam prin poștă. Las-o baltă.

entries.en: The ambassador to Mexico. Jesus, it doesn't matter who he is.
entries.ro: Ambasadorul din Mexic. Doamne, ce mai contează cine e?

entries.en: One more thing. Watch for Tygers. They've got their sights trained on your new companion.
entries.ro: Încă ceva. Ai grijă de Tygers. Au ochii pe noul tău companion.

entries.en: Wait, wait, what? He--... asshole hung up.
entries.ro: Stai, stai, ce? Ăla... jegosul ăla a închis.
